groups.label: Situational Gravity Shaping
groups.description: Opens the full advanced Situational Gravity shaping controls saved separately for this mode.

settings.name: gravityEnabled
settings.label: Enable gravity shaping (multi-step)
settings.description: OFF = single impulse only. ON = multi-step ramp pulses (Preset/Advanced).

settings.name: overrideGravity
settings.label: Customize gravity settings
settings.description: OFF = use built-in defaults. ON = use the Preset / Advanced controls below.

settings.name: gravityMode
settings.label: Gravity mode
settings.description: 0 = Realistic (tight/subtle), 1 = Gravity+ (heavier), 2 = Cinematic (floatier/more pulses)

settings.name: gravityFalloffMode
settings.label: Strength curve (per step)
settings.description: 0 = Exponential (strong first hit, then quickly fades). 1 = Linear (even fade each step; more mechanical).

settings.name: gravityBurstStepTime
settings.label: Gravity step spacing (sec)
settings.description: 0 = use the preset spacing from Gravity preset. >0 = use this exact spacing.

groups.label: Realism Plus Situational Overlay
groups.description: Optional Realism Plus scaling applied after the full situational values.

settings.name: realismPlus_multipliersEnabled
settings.label: Enable Realism Plus multipliers
settings.description: ON = apply the Realism Plus body/head/situational multipliers after the Realism Plus mode values are chosen.

settings.name: realismPlus_situationalDownScale
settings.label: situational down scale
settings.description: Multiplies Realism's tumble, stairs, directional, settle, and explosion downward forces.

settings.name: realismPlus_situationalUpScale
settings.label: situational up/lift scale
settings.description: Scales Realism's situational upward/lift force. Lower values reduce float.
